name: Messenger to Darkshire
objectiveText: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response. Ebonlocke's Response to Solomon (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: It seems like this is a pre-requisite for another quest or series of quests, but Solomon doesn't seem to give another.  Anyone know if this unlocks something in another NPC?
I actually got into this questline on my alt. Interesting story. I wanna know what unfolds now but there seem to be no more quests...anyone have any info? Thanks.

replies: does this quest line have any point or does it end here?

comments.body: Quest chain.  8 Quests of back and forth each time worth 50-250 exp.  What a joke!  Not worth it!
Haha I completed it at 57, gained 25 xp and 1s 50c for both quests, only 5 rep gain for the first and 3 for the second.
Better for rep though...25-50 per turn in for Stormwind.
I got 1000 for first turn in at level 18
theres no point to this line of quests. so dont really bother and u dont get any good exp only like 500 total.
replies:
Well the point is to get you to explore the various areas.  Which is useful to someone new to the game.  I suppose there is wow lore involved too.

But hey Xp + rep without having to kill anything.. sounds easy enough to me.
